analyzer.description: Sets the partyRole delegated to analyze actions within management of the Goal.

completionEvent.description: A happening that trigger to completion of the activity.

controlType.description: Establishes the control mechanism of the model

controller.description: Sets the partyRole delegated to direct decisions that control actions within management of the Goal.

design.description: Provides the design of the model. Human-centered design, machine-centered design or hybrid.

drive.description: States of model is policy driven or not.

dsecr.description: Short descriptive text for this Business Rule Management entry. Inherits from Entity ABE.

endActivity.description: Represents the action that trips the workflow. Linked to Activity ABE.

errorEvent.description: Identifies events that signal occurence of an error.

exceptionEvent.description: Identifies events to signal abnormalities of the workflow.

exitCondition.description: Identifies the condition to exit from the workflow.

framework.description: States the management framework for this model.

inputSource.description: Identifies source of input to the workflow.

manner.description: Strategy link between goal instrument and goal approach.

ontologySource.description: Establishes the source of ontology for the management model.

outputDestination.description: identifies a destination for the output of a workflow.

place.description: identifies the location where approval state was given.

planner.description: Sets the partyRole delegated to manage scheduling actions within management of the Goal.

processValue.description: Identifies the value to be assigned to the doAttribute.

reporter.description: Sets the partyRole delegated to provide reporting for all actions within management of the Goal.

startActivity.description: Represents the action that triggers the workflow. Linked to activity_id

startBy.description: Represents the trigger for a closedLoop to start.

state.description: Represents information the identifies goal management status over the lifecycle of the goal management.

stateReasons.description: Free hand text to provide reasons attributable to the approval state.

subType.description: Represents additional information that identify the secondary workflow types associated to a primary type.

subtype.description: A sub-category of a end trigger.

unit.description: Represents the unit constraining the domain of the value identified in business rule.

validFor.description: Period of time that signifies availability for use.

value.description: Represents the value to be assigned to this action.

whyInvoke.description: Sets the why of the business rule
